verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page documents Account and Contact management (accounts being companies) and AI syncing of emails and events, so the core record types and activity capture exist. The evidence never shows contacts linked to accounts or a per-record activity timeline view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contact-to-account linking, a full activity timeline on each record, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each
